metadata.attribution: The OpenSim Development Team (Jeff Reinbolt, Ajay Seth, Ayman Habib and Sam Hamner), adapted from Kate Holzbaur's upper-extremity model.
metadata.derivation: Sampled the supplied model at each integer degree of right elbow flexion with right shoulder elevation fixed at 0 degrees.
metadata.scope: Arm26 is a simplified, two-coordinate right arm with six muscle actuators and a fixed forearm rotation. Values describe generic model geometry.
metadata.lengthDefinition: Whole musculotendon path length, in meters.
metadata.momentArmDefinition: OpenSim signed elbow moment arm in meters, positive for flexion and negative for extension.

validation.method: Compared computeMomentArm with the negative finite difference of path length with respect to elbow angle in radians. Used a forward difference at 0 degrees and central differences elsewhere.
